lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots is organized into approximately four horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, creating a grid-like anchor system across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12-15 discrete, high-luminance spots of varying diameters are distributed across the surface of the first dorsal fin, with a slight clustering towards the anterior base.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a high-density distribution of smaller, less-organized high-luminance points compared to the structured grid pattern of the lateral flank.
